Ana (PM): FYI — ByteCloud asked for route-level cost visibility + trace hooks. they want a launch commitment. can we agree on MVP acceptance criteria by EOW?
Kevin (Eng): short: route-level cost from hourly rollups + trace sampling via SDK interceptors. full per-request billing is out for MVP. main risk: span ingestion lag and extra CPU for sampling.
Ella (Customer Success): customer needs: 1) top routes by estimated $/hr, 2) from a route click -> view recent traces with error filter, 3) filter by model & time window.
Maria (SRE): operational constraints: default sample=10%, force-sample on error for 48h after deploy. gate rollout on span-ingest lag <30s p90. add quota for spans.
Sam (Design): proposed UI: two-column page — left: cost leaderboard (sparkline, est $/hr), right: route detail with quick trace filters and a "why this cost" flyout. will post mock by EOD.
Kevin (Eng): rough effort: metrics surface = 2w, SDK + ingestion = 2w, rollout + canary = 1w (parallelize). expose metrics: `redwood.route.tokens.hourly_total`, `redwood.route.estimated_usd.hourly`. trace attrs: `route_id`, `model_name`.
telemetry-bot: dashboard created id=dg-99124 link=https://console.redwood/internal/dash/dg-99124
Ana (PM): Proposed MVP acceptance criteria:
- Console shows top 20 routes by estimated USD and token count for selected window.
- Route detail includes sample traces, filters (error / latency > p95), link to model & quant profile.
- Cost labeled as "estimated" with tooltip explaining hourly-rollup method.
- SDK interceptors available for Node/Python (gRPC & HTTP). default sample=10%; errors force-sampled for 48h.
- Performance: combined change adds <5ms to P95 generation latency on staging.
- Rollout: feature-flagged canary to 5% with auto-fallback to metrics-only if sampling lag > 2m.
Maria (SRE): add: abort canary if span ingestion lag or storage burn rate exceeds thresholds. schedule staging smoke test (50k req/min).
Ella (Customer Success): i'll draft a customer FAQ clarifying that Console estimates are not invoice-accurate.
Sam (Design): small add: CSV export for top routes for finance.
Kevin (Eng): implementation notes/snippet:
```
span.setAttribute('route_id', route.id)
span.setAttribute('model_name', model.name)
```
Also add env override `REDWOOD_TRACE_SAMPLING`.
Ana (PM): Decision checklist for EOW:
1) thumbs on MVP criteria
2) Sam posts mock by EOD
3) Kevin files epic + canary plan
4) Ella drafts FAQ
5) Maria schedules smoke test
Please react.
Kevin (Eng): :thumbsup:
Maria (SRE): :thumbsup:
Sam (Design): :thumbsup: will try to get mock early
Ella (Customer Success): :thumbsup: will prep FAQ
